title: The Oracle WebLogic console sign in page is reachable from the internet
summary: The Oracle WebLogic console is an administrative interface and its sign in page answers from the internet.  This proves it is exposed, not that it can be used without a password. It has a long history of authentication bypass and remote code execution, so keeping it off the internet matters more than usual.

confirm.control: A path that cannot exist, so the site's not found answer is known.
confirm.differential: status==200 and (body_contains("WebLogic Server") or body_contains("Oracle WebLogic")) and body_differs(control)

remediate: Put it behind a VPN or an allow list of networks, or take it off the public site.
